title: Source of truth and inventory with NetBox

videos.script: Where is the truth about your network? An address is in a spreadsheet. A cable is in a drawing. A site is in the monitoring system. And each of them is a little wrong. {{copies}} A source of truth is the decision that one place is right. Everything else is derived from it, or checked against it. {{sot}} In this lesson that place is NetBox. You read it through its API, from curl and from Python. {{api}} You add the one fact it does not have, and watch it refuse a wrong value. {{field}} Then lesson 10's template is fed from NetBox, and the configurations come out identical. {{render}} Nornir takes its inventory from it. NetBox hands out a free address. {{ipam}} And a change made in NetBox reaches exactly one router, with a record of who made it. {{change}}
